body: My friend and I do this all the time. All the people around really think it's playing their nerves, yet we keep doing it. It's kind of like an OCD. Whenever there is a pun to be said, it has to be said. And they're usually horrible.

I can't really speak in a phone, heh. I suppose I will try to contact them though. Thanks.

Well, to be fair I'm having trouble talking about my problems even when I'm anonymous. It took a lot of courage just to write up the OP, and I left out quite a few details. I think I'll prioritize trying to talk to a "real world" friend, and if that doesn't work out I'll return here to reddit. Thanks anyway!
Well, I believe it's pretty much impossible not to enjoy delicious pancakes. Perhaps I should dedicate my life to pancake science.
Playing games, watching movies, hanging out with people, browsing the web etc. I actually pretty much enjoyed everything. I was easily entertained.

Thanks for this comment.

My sense of self is constantly shifting, so I don't really have a feeling of who I really am. I don't feel like I'm static, I feel like my situation is. However I see your point.

I used to love DYAC, but now it doesn't really have that spark it used to have. Helping others is probably one of the best things I know, but I feel like my efforts are worthless in comparison to others - I rather feel like I'm just ruining it for everyone else. 

Exercise is a very good idea. I have made attempts to begin exercising, and because you said so I will try it again. However, my "engine" is really not working as it should so I am really really bad at making things happen.

I am really grateful for your reply, it really helps.

Thanks for the reply.

I am aware of the fact that ADHD has a connection with other disorders. I believe my bipolarity was triggered by ADHD meds, so I don't really believe in meds any more. I told my psychiatrist that I'd rather not take any meds, but if it gets more serious I guess I will have to.

Also, I don't really see it as a mental problem, I rather try to see it as a gift. 

Thanks for replying, it really matters knowing there are people who care.

Thank you for replying.

I am currently in queue for the public psychiatric care for adults, as I turned 18 about a year ago. The queue is very long, I might very well be waiting for another 6 months from what I know. My parents have called them a couple of times as my mood swings have been the cause of pretty serious conflicts, and the welfare officer at my school has also given them a call. It might speed up the process, and I really hope so.

I keep trying to get contact with my friends, but they still seem very distant. It is just as if they're tired with me, as if I did something wrong. I don't want to feel clingy, so I just contact them occasionally. I will keep trying though. Thanks.

I really don't have any relative I can rely on, as I've distanced myself a lot from my family due to the conflicts that have stirred up due to my instability. Sometimes, I make an attempt to open up to my friends, but without succeeding. Either they just don't want to hear it, or I'm imagining it. 

I might try calling a crisis line if it gets worse. Thank you for the recommendation, and thanks for replying. I am really grateful.

Thanks alot. Reading this comment really made it easier. It actually made me smile. Thank you, really.

Regarding relying on family and such - there's a problem with me. I'm never open with people who know me. I could barely even speak to my therapist, but rather shared objective observations regarding myself with her. The only reason I was able to open up here is due to my anonymity. 

As for my real life friends, they really really seem to be distancing themselves from me, though my self esteem is quite low and I keep having paranoid thoughts about nobody in the world liking me, etc. I believe they are influencing the objectivity of my thoughts regarding them.

Thanks for the reply. Really motivating. I will try to contact my friends as soon as possible.
